meta.name: CineStill 50D
notes: CineStill publishes no technical data. CineStill 50D is reported to be Kodak Vision3 50D (5203) with its rem-jet anti-halation backing removed, processed in C-41; this look is the 5203 datasheet curves printed on a colour paper.
The red glow around highlights (halation) is modelled; its radius, threshold and strength are Grainy's choice, not published values.
